title: The final_v2_REALLY_final problem

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Welcome to Lantern Labs! You're our new intern. We're building the website for the Riverside Lantern Festival.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Look at these files. Have you ever named a file 'final_v2_REALLY_final.txt'?

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: It gets confusing fast. Version control systems like git solve this by keeping a history of your changes safely.

questions.prompt: Why do we use version control?

choices.text: To keep track of file history without weird names

questions.explanation: Version control remembers history for you, so your files stay clean.

recap: Version control tracks your changes so you don't have to rename files.
